name: FAN EXPO Canada
blurb: FAN EXPO HQ's flagship Canadian show at the Metro Toronto Convention Centre, with celebrity, anime, gaming and comic-creator guests.

editions.evidence: Page JSON-LD: Event "FAN EXPO Canada" 2027-08-26 -> 2027-08-29 @ Metro Toronto Convention Centre; same text on page: 'AUGUST 26 - 29, 2027 METRO TORONTO CONVENTION CENTRE'.

notes: Multi-city FAN EXPO HQ (Informa) brand; this file covers Toronto only. All five guest category pages (celebrities, animation-voices, anime-guests, comic-creators, cosplayers) show a 'PAST FAN FAVE GUESTS INCLUDED' section of prior years' guests (Mark Hamill, John Cena, Elijah Wood, etc.) plus 'Sign up to the e-newsletter for ... updates' copy -- no names are tagged to the 2027 show yet, so guests is 'none-yet' per the rule for a page still showing last year's lineup. The gaming-guests link (/gamers/) currently 404s back to the homepage. Cover falls back to the plain 'FAN EXPO' wordmark logo since every carousel/hero image is a generic stock photo (crowds, past-guest photo ops) or a 'CELEBRATING FANDOM' text-pattern graphic, not edition-specific key art.
